name: Brute Force: BFS From Every Node
summary: Root the tree at each node in turn and BFS to find its height (the farthest distance). Keep the nodes whose height is smallest — those are the minimum-height-tree roots. The honest O(n * (n + e)) baseline.
visualizationIntent: init: build the undirected graph. loop: for each node as a root, BFS outward with a queue, tracking the farthest distance reached (the tree height). update: record each root's height; roots achieving the smallest height so far stay green. return: the node(s) with minimum height.
